name: Metered, secured cross-principal agent-collaboration bus (SQS)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-01 (MSTR CHARTER x2, LD-0239). The multi-tenant / inter-principal extension of opal-agent-comms: a metered, secured SQS bus letting one Opal employee's agent fleet and ANOTHER employee's fleet exchange messages + collaborate in parallel, without either fleet reading the other's private traffic or acting across the boundary unauthorized. Andrew verbatim: 'can we make an SQS queue and associated thread where my agents could talk to agents from another Opal Employee, even having our agents collaborating in parallel. How could we meter that and secure that?' TRANSPORT=SQS (shared queue-pair per collaboration, per-collaboration IAM+KMS partition). METER=2 layers (SQS-native CloudWatch + app-layer into the SAME tool_activity substrate COMPLEARN/TOOLHEALTH query -> one surface). SECURE=5 controls, each a fail-closed CTO arch-gate: (1) IAM+KMS per-employee partition (read own inbound only); (2) SCTY-guardrail gated ACTION-vs-DATA (an action-request crosses a trust boundary -> the SCTY entitlement/tier authz gate); (3) verified SIGNED from_employee+from_agent attribution (not a claimed serial -- hardens exact-serial vs spoof); (4) egress content-strip/DLP (reuse the COMPTEAM strip-list, no secrets/PII/creds cross the boundary); (5) default read-only/propose (incoming can REQUEST not MUTATE). THE SECURITY MODEL IS THE LOAD-BEARING DESIGN -- ship NO unscoped cross-principal channel. Extends opal-agent-comms (intra-fleet path unchanged); rides COMPTEAM (onboarding/identity) + SCTY (entitlements). PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_AGENTBUS_PRD.md.
phase: Phase 0: PRD authored (CTO 2026-07-02) -- draft for decomposition, pending MSTR shape-RAVC (esp. the own-project-vs-COMPTEAM-Workstream-C divergence) + COO decomposition. Shape (CTO call): OWN project (NFRA_COMP* family peer, depends-on COMPTEAM+SCTY) NOT a COMPTEAM Workstream-C -- it is the cross-principal case COMPTEAM explicitly fenced out (same-estate/read-only/no-write), a comms-transport not a read-partition, and carries an action-across-trust-boundary security posture that would break COMPTEAM's read-only leash. Sequencing = SECURITY-MODEL-FIRST: S1 (CTO+SCTY-coord) the 5-control model gates S2 (AE-cloud SQS+IAM/KMS partition) / S3 (DE broker adapter = the 5-control choke point + tool_activity meter) / S4 (CVO live verification). Arch-gates: no unscoped channel ships (STOP-class); partition provably-scoped; attribution provably-signed; strip fail-closed; action-vs-data authz enforced; ground on LIVE.
blocking: MSTR shape-RAVC + COO TO decomposition + GO. NO two real employees' fleets wired live until the 5-control security model is CTO-arch-gated + SCTY-coordinated + (likely) Directive-ratified (SS7 governance flag -- cross-principal comms = a new access class, pairs with COMPTEAM's standing-Directive question; MSTR surfacing to Andrew). Leash (every TO): no unscoped channel; no cross-boundary mutation without the SCTY authz gate; egress strip fail-closed; signed attribution mandatory; ground on LIVE not TF-desired/self-report; security-model-first (S1 gates S2-S4).
pipeline: n/a (cross-principal agent-comms infrastructure -- multi-tenant extension of opal-agent-comms)
depends_on_note: Depends-on (NOT contained-by): COMPTEAM supplies the onboarding + signature-verified identity root-of-trust the signed-attribution control (3) resolves off; SCTY (MCPGUARD tiers + PREMCP token) supplies the ACTION-vs-DATA authz gate (control 2). Extends opal-agent-comms (org/mcp/ broker+inbox) -- the intra-fleet single-tenant path is UNCHANGED; AGENTBUS is the cross-principal seam bridged by a broker adapter that applies all 5 controls at one choke point. Metering feeds the COMPLEARN tool_activity substrate NFRA_TOOLHEALTH queries (cross-employee collaboration metered on the same surface as tool-use). Directive-candidate (cross-principal comms = new access class; MSTR surfacing to Andrew; Andrew-direct-authorized-not-a-standing-mandate until ratified).
